title: TreeFlowNet Provenance Registry Schema V3
description: Schema enforcing end-to-end traceability for every scene, mosaic, tile, and annotation in TreeFlowNet.

tile_id.description: Unique identifier of the tile, formatted as {split}:{mosaic_id}_{tile_index}.

scene_id.description: Broader geographic scene identifier or regional cluster.

mosaic_id.description: Identifier of the source orthomosaic raster.

survey_id.description: Flight acquisition or aerial survey mission identifier, if independently verified.

acquisition_date.description: UTC date of aerial flight acquisition. Must be null if inferred only from file naming.

original_source_path.description: Path to original raw or prepared raster archive.

sha256_hash.description: SHA256 checksum of the tile content.

split_role.description: Authorized experimental role of the tile.

affine_transform.description: 6-element affine transformation matrix [a, b, c, d, e, f].

annotation_ids.description: List of COCO annotation IDs contained within this tile.

license_provenance.description: Dataset license, terms of use, or data citation.

provenance_status.description: Epistemic verification state of the record metadata.
